The '''Holgorian IM-220''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model that was produced by the [[Je'daii Order]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]].

==Description==
The Holgorian IM-220 was a small droid which used padded metal feet to move around. It was capable of limited communication with a Human master and other duties not necessarily exclusive to ship maintenance.

==History==
One notable example of this model was the [[Ironholgs|personal droid]] of [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Je'daii Order]]. She had customized the droid with heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]], doubling its weight but also making it helpful in risky situations. Lanoree called him [[Ironholgs]]<ref name="DotJ-ItV-p9">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>,an Armoredman.
